movies.title: Kalki: 2898 AD - Chrono Force
movies.tagline: When the world falls into darkness, the tenth avatar rises.
movies.synopsis: A modern-day mythological sci-fi epic set in a dystopian future year 2898 AD. Bhairava, a bounty hunter, embarks on a fate-altering journey through Shambhala and Kasi to protect the miraculous unborn child who holds humanity’s salvation.

movies.title: Leo: Bloody Sweet
movies.tagline: Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.
movies.synopsis: A mild-mannered cafe owner in Himachal Pradesh becomes an overnight hero after foiling an armed robbery, but the notoriety attracts relentless drug lords who believe he is their long-lost enforcer.

movies.title: Kantara: A Legend Chapter 1
movies.tagline: When faith is tested, the divine roars.
movies.synopsis: Exploring the genesis of the divine folk deity Panjurli during the reign of the Kadamba empire, unravelling ancient tribal legends, devotion, and sacred forest protection.

movies.title: Manjummel Boys
movies.tagline: Friendship beyond the depths of darkness.
movies.synopsis: A close-knit group of friends from a small town in Kerala embark on a holiday trip to Kodaikanal. Their vacation turns into a nail-biting rescue mission when one falls into the infamous Guna Caves.

movies.title: Rudra: The Fire Within
movies.tagline: Courage is born in the heart of rebellion.
movies.synopsis: A fearless cop operating in the heartlands uncovers a deep-rooted syndicate threatening national security. He takes law and justice into his own hands.

movies.title: Dune: Prophecy & Power
movies.synopsis: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe.

movies.title: Parasite: Shadow of the Citadel
movies.synopsis: A gripping social thriller following two families on opposite poles of modern Seoul whose lives intertwine through deception, luxury, and underground secrets.

movies.title: Chronicles of Elysium
movies.tagline: Beyond the horizon of memory lies the forgotten realm.
movies.synopsis: In futuristic Neo-Tokyo, a memory architect accidentally unlocks the suppressed historical record of humanity’s original contact with ancient celestial guardians.

movies.title: Subhash: The Unfinished War
movies.tagline: Freedom is not given, it is taken.
movies.synopsis: A grand historical epic uncovering the secret intelligence archives of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and the brave soldiers of the Indian National Army.

movies.title: Swarajya: Maratha Yoddha
movies.synopsis: The legendary military tactics and unyielding spirit of the Maratha hill fort commanders who defended the realm against overwhelming odds.

movies.title: Sher-E-Punjab: The Lion King of Lahore
movies.tagline: One Crown. One Pride. Everlasting Glory.
movies.synopsis: The majestic rise of Maharaja Ranjit Singh, bringing together divided confederacies into an invincible sovereign empire of prosperity and religious harmony.

movies.title: Abhigyan: The Vedic Chronology
movies.tagline: The timeless resonance of ancient Sanskrit wisdom.
movies.synopsis: An astronomical archaeologist decodes the hidden celestial alignments embedded within classical Sanskrit manuscripts, discovering an ancient energy network.

movies.title: Ghalib: Shehr-e-Sukhan
movies.tagline: Poetry carved into stone and sorrow.
movies.synopsis: A heartfelt romantic drama set in the winding alleys of 19th-century Shahjahanabad, celebrating the timeless couplets of Mirza Ghalib.

movies.title: Kutch: Colours of the White Desert
movies.tagline: Every thread has a song. Every heart has a desert.
movies.synopsis: A heartwarming story of an artisanal embroidery community in Kutch, whose vibrant art bridges generational divides and triumphs at global fashion week.

movies.title: El Último Tango en Buenos Aires
movies.tagline: When two souls meet in rhythm, words are superfluous.
movies.synopsis: A world-champion tango master and an ambitious street dancer form an electrifying partnership, confronting past betrayals and international rivals.

movies.title: Le Mystère de l’Ombre
movies.tagline: The city of lights conceals the darkest shadows.
movies.synopsis: A cunning art detective races through Paris’s subterranean catacombs to solve the impossible theft of a priceless Renaissance manuscript.
